# Abernethy Beck

> > Abernethy Beck is a 25+ year provider of premium laser systems, replacement parts, and fume extraction solutions for industrial material processing and precision engraving.

Abernethy Beck specializes in distributing and supporting Universal Laser Systems equipment, ABI laser systems, and comprehensive replacement parts catalogs. The company serves customers across industrial, commercial, and specialized marking applications with both new equipment sales and aftermarket support.

## Key Topics

- Universal Laser Systems
- ABI Laser Systems
- CO2 laser technology
- Fiber laser systems
- ULTRA series (X6000, R9000, R5000)
- VLS platforms (VLS6.75, VLS4.75, VLS3.75)
- PLS platforms
- Laser optics and replacement parts
- BOFA fume extraction
- Laser cartridge exchange program
- Material processing and engraving
- Precision marking systems
- UCP (Universal Control Panel)
- Intelligent Materials Database
- Industrial equipment support

## Laser Systems - ULTRA Series

- [ULTRA X6000 Laser System](https://abernethybeck.com/products/ultra-x6000): ULTRA X6000 with Multi-Wave Hybrid technology for precision material processing.
- [ULTRA R9000 Laser System](https://abernethybeck.com/products/ultra-r9000): ULTRA R9000 dual CO2 and fiber laser system with 300W power.
- [ULTRA R5000 Laser System](https://abernethybeck.com/products/ultra-r5000): ULTRA R5000 versatile laser system with 150W dual laser support.

## Laser Systems - Universal Platforms

- [Universal Laser Systems: Precision Cutting & Engraving](https://abernethybeck.com/collections/universal-laser-systems-1): Universal Laser Systems product catalog with ULTRA and platform models.
- [PLS6.150D Platform](https://abernethybeck.com/products/pls6-150d-platform): Universal Laser PLS6.150D CO2 laser platform for industrial applications.
- [Universal Laser Systems VLS6.75](https://abernethybeck.com/products/vls6-75-platform): VLS6.75 CO2 laser cutter and engraver with 10-75W power options.
- [Universal Laser Systems VLS4.75](https://abernethybeck.com/products/vls4-75-platform): VLS4.75 CO2 laser platform for precision cutting and engraving.
- [Universal Laser Systems VLS3.75](https://abernethybeck.com/products/vls3-75-platform): VLS3.75 compact CO2 laser system for versatile material processing.

## Laser Systems - ABI Series

- [ABI Laser Systems](https://abernethybeck.com/collections/abi-laser-systems): ABI laser system product line including UV and fiber laser models.
- [FMO.100 Laser System](https://abernethybeck.com/products/fmo-100-laser-system): ABI FMO.100 fiber laser system with MOPA technology for metal marking.
- [UVO.10 UV Laser System](https://abernethybeck.com/products/uvo-10-uv-laser-system): ABI UVO.10 UV laser system for precision marking on delicate materials.

## Replacement Parts & Accessories

- [Universal Laser System Parts & Accessories](https://abernethybeck.com/collections/universal-laser-systems): Product catalog of Universal Laser Systems parts and replacement accessories.
- [Universal Laser Systems Laser Exchange Program](https://abernethybeck.com/collections/uls-laser-cartridge-replacements): ULS laser cartridge exchange program with certified replacements and warranty.
- [Universal Laser Optics](https://abernethybeck.com/collections/universal-laser-optics): Product collection of laser optics and lens assemblies for ULS systems.
- [Belts and Bearings](https://abernethybeck.com/collections/belts-and-bearings): Replacement belts and bearings for Universal Laser Systems equipment.
- [Universal Laser Accessories](https://abernethybeck.com/collections/universal-laser-accessories): Rotary attachments, cutting tables, and accessories for ULS platforms.

## Fume Extraction & Environmental

- [BOFA Fume Extraction Filters](https://abernethybeck.com/collections/bofa-filters): Product catalog of BOFA replacement filters for fume extraction systems.
